targets.title: The folk concept of intentionality
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted two pre-registered direct replications of the Malle and Knobe (1997) Study 1.
targets.outcome_quote: We conducted two pre-registered replications of Study 1 (N=46; N=817). The replication results provide support for the findings of the original study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors give an overall supportive verdict for their replication. Exploratory actor-observer analyses do not supersede that overall verdict.

reasoning: Two new samples re-test the single published target paper. Identity verified by full title and author list in the accepted manuscript; references included. Exploratory pooled analyses include original data but the primary investigation is new-sample replication.
